newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MICEX details dollar, T-bill futures trade.
newsitem.headline: MICEX details dollar, T-bill futures trade.

text.p: The Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX) said on Tuesday it will launch trading in $1,000 dollar futures and 10 GKO Treasury bill futures on Thursday.

Chief executive Alexander Zakharov told Reuters the contracts would have monthly settlement dates, running up to 12 months for the dollars and six months for the T-bills. The contracts would be traded on a non-delivery basis.
The nominal value of cash T-bills is one million roubles.
Zakharov said trading will take place daily from 1315 till 1445 Moscow time. Settlement will be on a T+2 basis.
He said 105 accredited resident financial companies will trade on an automated system at the MICEX floor and from remote terminals.
MICEX intended to start futures trading in March but the start was postponed at the central bank's request as the regulatory background had not been fully prepared.
